part.text:
Implemented the fix in `include/fmt/format.h:2687`.

The bug: when floating-point output was localized and had a nonzero integer part (`exp > 0`), separator padding was counted against the whole significand instead of just the integer digits (`exp`). This overcounted separators, making the field one column too narrow relative to zero-integer values. All format/printf/xchar tests pass.
